finalModel: Hierarchy is multi-scale variance structure in dO. Necessary: var(dO)>0. Enhancing: kurtosis (r=-0.855 strongest predictor) and skew (r=-0.649). Heavy-tailed dO produces deepest hierarchy. Hierarchy grows as log(T).
supportedClaims: Variance is NECESSARY for hierarchy (uniform dO -> no hierarchy)
Kurtosis is the STRONGEST hierarchy predictor (r=-0.855)
Hierarchy grows as log(T) — logarithmic scaling
